fix(dial): a dial that lands after its bound or its stream's close is closed, not leaked (candybar-testing-ihvy.5em)

feat(dial): the client reaches its daemon through one dialer port, and no test hand-rolls a socket (candybar-testing-ihvy.5em)

A Dialer port (src/dial/) with one adapter over a unix socket, an in-memory fake that listens and holds paths on a clock, and one contract both pass. The round trip, the frame stream and acquire's probe dial through the World's dialer; a dial's refusal is typed at the adapter, so interpretException reads no errno out of a message. Lint keeps net in the adapter and the daemon's listener, in src and in tests. The nine test files that stood up their own sockets listen on the fake; the kernel bind cases move to test/integration.

fix(test): the parent-watchdog case waits for the anchor's reap and the daemon's whole group, and proves the watchdog ended it (brandon-menus-sjhy.26f)

fix(test): the launch-group abort case reaches its window by what it observes, not a sleep (brandon-menus-sjhy.irc) (#653)

* fix(test): the launch-group abort case reaches its window by what it observes, not a sleep (brandon-menus-sjhy.irc)

The case means one state: the child ended, its group is gone, and the launch
has not yet sampled the group. A 1300 ms sleep aimed at it, so a loaded
machine saw the launch's own sample land first and read ok:true.

The case now launches on a held clock, so the launch samples the group only
when the case advances it. It waits, by condition, for the child's pidfile,
for the group's end, and for the launch to have seen the exit, then aborts
and advances. The holder outside the group, which keeps the child's close
from concluding first, lives until the case removes its directory, not for
3 s of real time.

The launcher's owner moves into launcherOn(clock), shared by the beforeEach
and this case.

* fix(test): the launch-group cases end their holders by removing a path, and the timeout case samples a live group on a held clock (brandon-menus-sjhy.irc)

The abort and timeout cases each sample the group alive, end its member, then
act before the next poll. Every holder waits on the case's directory, which
afterEach removes, so no case bets on a holder's lifetime in real time.

* fix(test): the exit-code case arms a timeout it never reaches, and each loop run's holder ends with its run (brandon-menus-sjhy.irc)

A fired timeout concludes on the gone group as ok, so a timeout inside the
case's life hid a launch that waited for its holder.
fix(draw): a frame's lanes are noted before its walk, so a frame that throws still says which lanes it drew for (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.0se)
refactor(draw): a view's draw returns the lane switches it drew under; two comments name lane frames (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.0se)

fix(facts): a replay draws the lane feeds and diagnostics the live draw was handed, and the frames a lane drew (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.0se)

A replay drew every frame with every lane idle, no open viewer, and only
the request answers, so a recording of a session with a lane following or
the warnings viewer open replayed a bar the user never saw.

- A draw line is one draw of the view, an answer or a lane's frame: it
  carries the instant it was drawn at and what it was handed (who it drew
  for, each lane's feed, the diagnostics list). A lane's frames write the
  view's frame memory and the session's effect memory, so the recorder
  notes each one, to every recording of the session, and the replay draws
  them in the file's order at their exact instants. RECORDING_VERSION 6.
- The daemon and the demo draw a view through one function (draw-view),
  which derives every draw projection from what the draw was handed and
  stands the open viewer in for the bar. The demo's own drawDsl call goes.
- A recording that holds only lane frames is kept and replays; `record`
  reports answers and lane frames.
- The seam test's live side is the daemon's draw throughout, and a new case
  replays a standing warning, a following lane, its toggles and the open
  viewer, compared whole.

feat(band): a switched-off band lane holds no follower process (candybar-animation-wbxz.w33)

The band mod stops its follow child on the daemon's SWITCHED_OFF answer
instead of keeping it alive to re-ask every 5s, and turning band (A) off
uninstalls the mod so sessions started afterwards never load it. An
uninstall of a mod that is not installed is the state off asks for, so it
is said rather than thrown.
